summary: The RMR Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its majority-owned subsidiary, RMR LLC, entered into amended management agreements with Office Properties Income Trust (OPI) upon OPI's emergence from Chapter 11 bankruptcy on June 17, 2026. The new agreements have a five-year initial term, with an annual business management fee of $14 million for the first two years, a 3% property management fee, and a 5% construction supervision fee. RMR LLC also received 2% of OPI's common equity on the effective date and is eligible for up to 8% of OPI's common equity upon achieving performance metrics. This marks OPI's reorganization exit; watch for execution and equity milestones.
